Maya (HW Partnerships): Heads up — Sable Systems confirmed next-week access to their new 4U board. We need to lock the joint perf/W run plan and decide which kernel knobs to push for the marketplace checklist. Who can drive the runbook?

Liam (Perf Eng): I can own the runbook. Proposal: two-stage run — baseline (stock kernel, float16) then tuned (kernel patches + int8 q). Measure throughput, p95 latency, and watts with external power meter.

Andrea (DevRel): +1. Also we should capture reproducible steps for the marketplace AMI/container and a short howto for SI integrators. Want a 1-pager we can share with partner comms.

Sam (SiteOps): Need to reserve rack and PDUs — can do Wed/Thu window next week. Also need target thermals so we can set the fans and cooling profile ahead of the run.

Liam (Perf Eng): Draft run matrix below. Thoughts?

bench-bot: run-matrix created at /mnt/bench/run-matrix-3298765432.csv

Liam (Perf Eng): Matrix (short):
- models: llama-3-13b, llama-3-70b
- batch sizes: 1, 4, 8
- seq len: 512, 1024
- kernel variants: stock, kernel-v2 (KV-cache perf), kernel-v2+tiling
- quant: fp16, int8
- telemetry tags: partner=sable, hw_rev=4U-v1, env=marketplace-staging

Maya (HW Partnerships): Good. Partner asked for perf/W normalized to 1k tokens. Also they want the final numbers in a slide for the joint announcement. Can we get a perf/W delta column?

Liam (Perf Eng): We'll compute tokens-per-joule and include delta vs stock. I'll add automated aggregation. Example command we'll run on the bench node:

```
sudo ./run_profiler --model llama-3-70b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --kernel kernel-v2 --power-sensor /dev/power0 --out /tmp/sable-run.json
```

Andrea (DevRel): For the marketplace listing we need: validated AMI/container hash, security checklist, and a short compatibility note for SI (driver/kernel deps). I'll draft the marketplace blurb once we have hashes.

Sam (SiteOps): FYI we'll tag the nodes with k8s labels so CI picks the right hardware: `sable=true hw_rev=4u-v1`. Also ensure we capture i2c power telemetry at 1s resolution.

Maya (HW Partnerships): Timeline suggestion:
- Mon: runbook + run-matrix final review
- Wed/Thu: lab runs (partner on-site remote watch)
- Fri: data aggregation + internal review
- Next Tue: draft joint slide + partner review

Liam (Perf Eng): Sounds good. Need signoff on kernel patches to test (kernel-v2 and tiling patch). @Sam can you stage the kernel images on the bench nodes by Tue EOD?

Sam (SiteOps): Yep, I'll stage images and post checksums. Also will install the power meter drivers.

Andrea (DevRel): Let's set expectations for the announcement: don't promise specific perf gains, frame as "validated efficiency improvements under partner-tested configs". We'll coordinate messaging with partner PMs.

Maya (HW Partnerships): Agreed. Also, partner asked for a short SI integration note about fallback behavior when quantized kernels aren't available. Liam — can you add a test for model fallback to the baseline model variant?

Liam (Perf Eng): Will add a quick smoke test: if kernel fails, fallback to stock kernel and emit a metric `runtime.fallback=true`. Example log snippet I'll include in runbook: 

```
[run] loaded kernel-v2
[run] quant init ok
[run] runtime error: kernel-v2 tiling OOM
[run] falling back to: stock-kernel
[metrics] runtime.fallback=true
```

Maya (HW Partnerships): Perfect. Can everyone drop final comments by EOD Monday so I can send the runbook to Sable? I'll also include a short NDA excerpt and the joint comms timeline.

Andrea (DevRel): Putting a placeholder PR in the docs repo: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/pulls/321 — will update with AMI/container steps.

bench-bot: scheduled run window: 2026-03-25T09:00Z to 2026-03-26T18:00Z (reserved rack ID: sable-4u-01)

Sam (SiteOps): Rack reserved, PDUs ready. I'll post checksums here once images are staged.

Liam (Perf Eng): Final ask — please confirm what SLA the partner expects for the marketplace listing latency/availability so we can add it to the Console dashboard demo.

Maya (HW Partnerships): Partner expects 99.9% availability and <120ms p95 for their targeted 512-seq profile. We'll include a per-route dashboard sample.

Andrea (DevRel): :thumbsup: adding that to the draft.

Maya (HW Partnerships): Thanks all — I'll compile and circulate the runbook by Monday 14:00 PT. If anyone sees blocker post here or DM. :sparkles:
